fullText:
Good morning. Here is your daily brief for Friday 5 June 2026.

Walthamstow: 16°C, partly cloudy, high 18° / low 12°, 20% chance of rain.

GBP/USD 1.346 · GBP/ILS 3.892.

🤖 AI models and products
- Anthropic announced annualized revenue crossed $47 billion in May, up dramatically from roughly $9 billion at the end of 2025, as CEO Daniela Amodei heads into the company's IPO <https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/ahead-of-its-ipo-anthropics-daniela-amodei-shrugs-off-doubts-about-ais-returns/>
- Poke became the first AI agent approved on Apple's Messages for Business platform, letting users interact with AI agents through simple text messages <https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/04/apple-approves-poke-as-the-first-ai-agent-on-its-messages-for-business-platform/>
- Lovable signed a multiyear deal with Google Cloud involving a 5x expansion of its footprint on Google Cloud and expanded access to Anthropic Claude <https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/03/lovable-signs-multi-year-deal-with-google-cloud-to-up-usage-5x-source-says/>
- So what for you: Anthropic's revenue trajectory and agentic tools like Poke maturing on enterprise platforms mean AI-powered GTM workflows are moving from experimental to production faster than ever — start stress-testing integrations into your client tech stacks.

🛡️ AI safety & policy
- President Trump abandoned an AI executive order less than two weeks after issuing it, with a new version now under development that signals shifting regulatory priorities <https://www.technologyreview.com/2026/06/03/1138322/the-download-trump-ai-order-smart-glasses-warfare/>
- AI Snake Oil introduced CRUX, a new evaluation project for measuring frontier AI capabilities on long, messy open-world tasks rather than isolated benchmarks <https://www.normaltech.ai/p/open-world-evaluations-for-measuring>
- Researchers published a new paper quantifying the capability-reliability gap in AI agent systems, addressing concerns about whether frontier models perform reliably in real-world conditions <https://www.normaltech.ai/p/new-paper-towards-a-science-of-ai>
- So what for you: As a GTM advisor to AI-product companies, these shifting US policies and emerging reliability standards will affect how your clients position safety claims and model evaluations to enterprise buyers.

🇮🇱 Israeli politics
- A Zman Yisrael poll published this week indicates the Zionist opposition parties could form a government with 62 seats, though this would fall short if all Arab factions run on a joint slate. <https://www.timesofisrael.com/poll-shows-anti-netanyahu-bloc-winning-majority-eisenkot-seen-as-best-fit-to-be-pm-in-separate-survey/>
- Retired general Gadi Eisenkot is seen as the best fit to be Prime Minister in a separate survey, as elections loom with thousands marching to the Knesset for Jerusalem Pride while chanting democracy. <https://www.timesofisrael.com/part-of-a-larger-struggle-as-elections-loom-thousands-march-to-knesset-for-jerusalem-pride/>
- Netanyahu's government continues to face pressure from multiple fronts: Finance Minister Smotrich argues a ceasefire under current conditions with Hezbollah would be a major success, while Ben-Gvir and Eli Cohen call for harsher measures. <https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-898475/>
- So what for you: Israeli election polls matter for your GTM work advising Israeli tech firms on UK expansion, as coalition stability affects government spending and venture funding decisions that ripple through your client base.

📰 Hacker News top 3
- Entanglement Builds Space-Time. Now "Magic" Gives It Gravity <https://www.quantamagazine.org/entanglement-builds-space-time-now-magic-gives-it-gravity-20260603/>
- Tracing a powerful GNSS interference source over Europe <https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.03673>
- ESP32 Bit Pirate, a Hardware Hacking Tool with WebCLI That Speaks Every Protocol <https://github.com/geo-tp/ESP32-Bit-Pirate>

Today's question: With Anthropic's annualized revenue hitting 47 billion and agentic tools like Poke moving into production on enterprise platforms, are your Israeli SaaS clients asking you how to position their own AI capabilities to UK buyers before the regulatory landscape crystallizes further?
